description: A PHP class for converting SQL statements with named placeholders to positional placeholders, inspired by Doctrine DBAL and PHP PDO parser.

classes.name: NamedPlaceholderConverter
classes.description: A final class that converts SQL statements with named placeholders to positional placeholders, maintaining parameter mappings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the class and builds the regex pattern for parsing SQL statements.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses an SQL statement with named placeholders and maps parameters to positional placeholders.

methods.name: getAnsiSQLStringLiteralPattern
methods.description: Helper method to generate regex pattern for SQL string literals based on delimiter.

methods.name: addPositionalParameter
methods.description: Adds a positional placeholder '?' to the SQL and maps the corresponding parameter.

methods.name: addNamedParameter
methods.description: Replaces a named placeholder with '?' and maps the parameter value.

methods.name: addOther
methods.description: Adds non-placeholder SQL fragments to the converted SQL parts.

methods.name: getConvertedSQL
methods.description: Returns the SQL statement with positional placeholders.

methods.name: getConvertedParameters
methods.description: Returns the array of parameters corresponding to the positional placeholders.
